FN-KHJ14AU-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 271
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/10/2025
Senate Bill 271 as introduced would not affect state funding. This bill would prohibit franchise
fees, charges, taxes or other payments paid by certain natural or manufactured gas utilities from
being increased after December 31, 2025, unless approved by a majority of the qualified electors
residing in the city to vote on the proposed increased fees.
Page 1

FN-KHJ14AU-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 271
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/28/2025
Senate Bill 271 as passed the Senate would prohibit municipal franchise fees, charges, taxes or
other payments paid by certain natural or manufactured gas utilities from being increased after
December 31, 2025, unless approved by municipal referendum.
